    (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n,
      ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k))) =
      (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ n) - (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ n) := by
  intro n hle
  have hprod :
      ∀ m : ℕ,
        (∏ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k))) =
          (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) - (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ m ih =>
        calc
          (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.succ m),
              ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k))) =
              (∏ k ∈ Finset.range m,
                ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ k))) *
                ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m)) := by
                simpa [Finset.prod_range_succ]
          _ = ((3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) - (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m)) *
                ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m)) := by
                simpa [ih]
          _ = (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ (Nat.succ m)) - (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ (Nat.succ m)) := by
                have h1 :
                    ((3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) - (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m)) *
                      ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m) + (3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m))
                    = ((3 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m))^2 - ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ m))^2 := by
                  ring
                have h2 :

                  simpa [pow_mul] using (pow_mul (3 : ℤ) (2 ^ m) 2).symm
                have h3 :

                have h4 :
